text:
Sam (Partnerships): kicking off IvyBridge Systems preview EAP. NDA countersigned this AM. Need quick decisions: benchmark matrix, telemetry guardrails (partner wants finer-grain), SI handoff logistics, and marketplace packaging + embargo. Keep replies short.

Ellen (Eng-ML): propose matrix: batches [1,8,64], seqs [128,512,1536], models: rwd-gpt-2.2b, community-9b-q4. Measure: p50/p95 latency, sustained tokens/sec, GPU mem, power wattage, and a 300-sample quality check (BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxies). I'll run the experiments.

Tor (Infra): staging harness uploaded: gs://redwood-eap/ivybridge/harness-v4.tar.gz. Need partner public key for bastion (10.55.5.0/24) and a signed SR to datacenter ops. Note: IvyBridge boards ship with a thermal governor; partner offered a firmware toggle for soak runs. I'll coordinate a Friday firmware window.

Ben (Legal): partners requested 5-minute telemetry exports. We should avoid any raw request payload or per-user traces. Draft amendment: allow perf counters in 5-min buckets with strict prohibition on request text and user ids + access log auditing. Will post wording.

Clara (Product): marketplace draft is in drive. Partner requests badge "IvyBridge-Accelerated" and co-branded hero. Marketing loves "Accelerated"; legal may prefer "Validated". We also need to decide whether to mention specific model/quantization combos in listing.

Ellen (Eng-ML): run snippet for steady-state we will use (dropping into CI ticket):

```bash
# steady warmup + measure for IvyBridge
python perf_runner.py --model rwd-gpt-2.2b --seq 1536 --batch 8 --warmup 400 --iters 1600 --log gs://redwood-eap/ivybridge/results/run01.log
```

Tor (Infra): creating JIRA: IVY-EAP-1 for lab booking, key exchange, and SR. Tentative lab slots Mon/Tue next week 09:00-17:00 PT; keep Fri open for firmware toggle. Also will capture per-socket power via PDUs.

Ben (Legal): uploaded amendment snippet: "Allowed telemetry: aggregated perf counters (5-min buckets), GPU temp (avg/max), power draw, and per-run p50/p95. Prohibited: raw request payloads, user identifiers, or traceable UUIDs. Access to telemetry requires partner counsel signoff and is audited." Please review and ack.

ops-bot: Perf job queued: ivy-990 (owner: Tor). CI: https://ci.redwood/runs/ivy-990

Sam (Partnerships): owners recap: Ellen (runs + prompts), Tor (infra + lab + PDU), Ben (legal redline), Clara (marketplace + comms). Timeline: baseline runs by +6d, firmware test +8d, legal finalize in 48h, marketplace copy freeze in 9d. Target joint announcement ~2 weeks post-baseline if no blockers.

Ellen (Eng-ML): small additional ask: include an A/B with partner scheduler enabled (they claim 15% perf win on long sequences). We'll capture both configs and name the listing "IvyBridge + Scheduler" for the A/B if it proves consistent.

Tor (Infra): will add A/B run configs to JIRA and include SI contact for scheduler handoff. Also will record per-GPU temps and PDU wattage every 30s.

Clara (Product): product note: if A/B shows consistent uplift, we'll use "IvyBridge-Accelerated" in listing; otherwise fallback to "IvyBridge-Validated". Need legal ok for scheduler claims.

Ben (Legal): :thumbsup: amendment looks fine, but we must ensure partner signs a logo usage MOU before co-branding. I'll draft MOU and telemetry access policy.

Ellen (Eng-ML): adding prompt set (300 samples) to shared drive and a short eval harness. Also including quantization checks to avoid regressions.

Tor (Infra): :white_check_mark: booked lab and uploaded run configs to JIRA.

Ben (Legal): :white_check_mark: MOU draft incoming EOD.

Clara (Product): :white_check_mark: looping in marketing and design.

Sam (Partnerships): thanks all. If partner pushes for raw exports again, offer a read-only secure dashboard with audited access and daily CSV exports only. React with :white_check_mark: when you accept tasks.

Ellen (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark: starting runs Thu morning.

Tor (Infra): :white_check_mark: doing keys and bastion rule now.

Ben (Legal): :white_check_mark: will send amendment to partner counsel.

Clara (Product): :white_check_mark: design + comms looped in.

Sam (Partnerships): keeping thread as audit. Ping me for blockers or if partner requests press alignment earlier than planned.
